caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware crock with a lid and two handles, one on each side. The crock is cylindrical with a slightly flared rim and straight sides, and it appears to be made of a light brown or tan material. The lid fits snugly on top and has a small, round handle at the center. A blue decorative floral or foliate design is painted on the front of the crock, and there are additional blue accents around the edge of the lid and on the handles. The surface texture of the crock suggests a glazed ceramic finish. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, highlighting the crock as the central object. The artist’s name, “JESSICA PRICE,” is faintly visible in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Earthenware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
